chapters.title: The Dino Trail
chapters.text:
Maya and Dad take a trail to the museum. The sign reads: MEET THE DINOSAURS!

A big beast stands in the hall. Its teeth are as long as Maya's arm. Its tail is like a road.

"That is a meat eater," Dad says.

Maya reads the sign. She says each word slow. Ea says /ee/. Ai says /ay/. Oa says /oh/.

She sees a dino with a beak. She sees a dino with a green coat of scales. She sees eggs in a nest of leaves.

A man in a lab coat waits by the last case. "Want to hold a real claw?" he asks.

Maya nods. The claw feels cold. It feels heavy. Her cheeks glow.

At home, Maya paints a dino on a sheet. She gives it a long tail and a wide beak.

"I will be a dino hunter," she says. "I will dig and read and learn."

transcript.title: Dino Eggs in the Oak Woods
transcript.text:
Maya loves dinosaur news. Today she reads about eggs.

Long ago, a dino made a nest by an oak tree. She laid three eggs in the soft dirt.

The mom was named Oat. She had a big beak and a long tail.

Oat ate green leaves all day. She did not leave the nest.

Rain came. Oat kept the eggs dry. Heat came. Oat made shade with a leaf.

One day a crack! A peep! A tiny dino came out of the egg.

Then two more! Three baby dinos, each with a tiny beak.

Oat let them eat seeds and leaves. They ate a lot!

The babies did not stray far. They kept close to Oat by the oak.

Maya read the page again. Scientists find real dino eggs in rock! Maya wants to find one, too.

chapters.title: Dino Rain Day
chapters.text:
Rain fell on the green hills. A big dino ate leaves by the lake.

Her name was Oak. Oak had a long neck and a flat beak.

The rain made a stream. The stream ran fast. Oak let out a squeak!

A small dino sat on a boat of bark. He float, float, floated!

"Wait!" said Oak. "I will help. Take my tail!"

The small dino did not wait. He grabbed the tail and held on.

Oak did not drop him. She made a road with her neck. Step, step, step!

Soon both dinos sat on dry soil. They ate leaves and beans in the heat.

The rain went away. A bright sun came out.

Real kids read about dinos each day. Scientists dig and find new bones! Some dinos had a beak. Some had a coat of feathers.

Oak did not read. Oak just ate leaves.

But Oak was a real, brave dino.

chapters.title: The Dino Boat Team
chapters.text:
Sam has a boat. The boat is on the lake.

Three toy dinos sit in the boat. They are a team.

The big one has a green coat of paint. He can float!

The small one has a beak. It can eat leaves.

Brachiosaurus had a long neck. She could reach him. She lifted T. rex to her back.

They all sailed to the beach as a team.

chapters.title: Dino Seed Snack
chapters.text:
Little Dino had a beak. His beak was made to eat.

Today the team had a plan. They would eat a big meal by the road.

Rain fell on the trail. Drip, drip, drip! But the team did not wait.

Dino saw a seed on a leaf. He ate the seed with his beak. Yum!

His pal Sail had a long tail. Her tail made a path in the rain.

The team ran to a boat. The boat sat on a lake. Hop, hop! All aboard!

The boat did float. It did not sink. Dino ate a green leaf on the boat.

The rain went away. The sun came out. Dino gave a happy squeak.

Scientists still dig up dino bones today. They read the bones like a book. Each bone can teach us a new fact!

Dino ate the last seed. "That was a fine meal," said the team.

transcript.text:
Maya sees a new dino race. Sixty dinos will run!

Some dinos eat meat. Some eat leaves. Today they all race on one trail.

Raptor slides! He lands in the mud with a splat.

Then both run. They reach the last gate at the same time!

The crowd claps. Two winners! Each gets a big green treat.

Maya grins. She likes a fast race. But she likes a good team more.

chapters.title: Dino Trail and the Green Coast
chapters.text:
Rain fell on the green trail. A big dino woke up.

"I will find my team," she said.

She made a wide trail in the mud. Her tail left a deep mark. Snails sat on a leaf.

Soon she saw the coast. A boat did float near the road. A small dino sat in it and ate a meal.

"Come eat!" he said. "I have leaves and seeds."

The big dino ate. The rain did stop. A sail went up, white and neat.

They did float down the coast. A bird with a long beak came too. It sat on the mast to nap.

"We are a team," said the big dino. "I can teach you the trail. You can teach me the sea."

They rode home at sunset.

Real dino fans read facts and play games at Nat Geo Kids. New science teaches us more each year!

The dinos won the big race. Now they camp by the lake.

chapters.title: Dino Rain on the Oak Road
chapters.text:
Rain fell on the oak road. A big dino team came out to play.

"Rain, rain!" said Pip. "I like rain!"

Pip led the team down the trail. The trail was wet. Each foot made a deep track in the mud.

A green leaf fell. Pip ate the leaf. It was a good meal!

The trail met the coast. A boat sat on the sand. The boat had a big sail.

"Can we sail?" said Pip.

"We can sail!" said the team.

The team got in the boat. The sail went up. Rain fell on the sail. The boat went down the coast.

Pip ate one more leaf on the way.

At home, Pip read a book. Real people dig up dino bones each year. They teach us what each dino ate!

"I like that," said Pip. "I ate a leaf too."

Rain fell on the oak road all night.

transcript.title: The Fossil Dig
transcript.text:
Maya goes to dino camp. Today the kids will dig for fossils!

The teacher gives each kid a pail and a small pick.

"Dig slow," she says. "A fossil can crack."

Maya kneels in the sand. She sweeps with her hand.

Tink! Her pick hits something hard.

She leans in close. She sees a gray shape in the clay.

"It is a tooth!" Maya cheers. "A real dino tooth!"

The teacher beams. "That tooth ate meat long ago."

Next the kids make a clay volcano. They pour in soap and it foams!

The goo creeps down like hot lava. The kids squeal.

At the end of the day, Maya takes her tooth home in a box.

She keeps it by her bed. Each night she dreams of dinos.

Today the team will sail a boat. The boat sits by the coast. The sea is calm. No rain. Not one drop of rain.

Pip gets a big green leaf. The leaf is her sail! Rex takes the oars. The team sails the boat away from the coast.

Soon, rain! Rain taps the boat. Rain taps the leaf. Pip holds the sail tight.

"Keep on!" says Rex. "We sail as a team!"

The rain stops. The boat lands on a sand trail. The trail goes up the road to home.

On the road, the team eats a meal. Each dino eats a leaf. Each dino is glad.

Did you know? Kids can read real dino facts and see dino art on the web. You can read and learn each day, just like Pip!

transcript.title: Maya at the Museum
transcript.text:
Maya goes to the museum. Big bones stand in the main hall!

A tall skeleton greets her. It is a T. rex. Its teeth are as long as her hand.

"Scientists found each bone in the ground," says Dad. "Then they put them back in place."

Maya sees a plate from a Stegosaurus back. She sees a claw. She sees a nest of eggs in gray stone.

Then Maya plays a game on a screen. She must match eight fossils to the right dino.

Click! The tail goes to the raptor. Click! The beak goes to the Triceratops.

She gets them all. The screen cheers!

Last, Maya draws her own dino. She gives it green skin, a long neck, and a sail.

"I will name it Maya-saurus," she says.

chapters.title: Stomp and the Shiny Shell
chapters.text:
Stomp is a big dino. Stomp has strong legs.

Stomp went down the steep path. Crunch! Crack! Stomp stepped on twigs.

Stomp saw a shiny shell in the sand. The shell was flat and smooth.

"Whose shell is this?" said Stomp.

A small dino ran up fast. "That is my shell!" she said. "I am Skip."

Skip and Stomp sat by the stream. They shared plums and green leaves.

Splash! A fish did a flip. Skip and Stomp did a flip too. Stomp fell flat, and Skip did a big grin.

Then Skip held up the shell. "You can keep it," said Skip. "A gift for a friend."

Stomp held the shell close. It shone like a star.

At home, Stomp read a dino book from Nat Geo Kids. It had facts, games, and art. Stomp read that new dino facts come out each year!

"Dinos are the best," said Stomp.

transcript.title: Maya-saurus Wakes Up
transcript.text:
That night, Maya dreams her drawing is real.

Maya-saurus stands by her bed! She has green skin, a long neck, and a tall sail.

"Climb on," she says. "I will show you my home."

Maya holds the sail. They float out the window and soar.

They land in a green field. Ferns grow up to Maya's waist.

Maya-saurus eats leaves from a tall tree. She reaches the top with ease.

A stream runs near. They both drink. The water is cool and clean.

Then Maya sees a real T. rex! He lets out a deep roar.

"Do not fear," says Maya-saurus. "He just yawned!"

The T. rex naps in the heat. His teeth gleam in the sun.

Maya paints the scene in her mind. Then she wakes in her own bed and grins.
transcript.cover_scene: A girl riding on the back of a friendly green sail-backed dinosaur soaring over a ferny prehistoric valley at dusk.

chapters.title: Chip the Dino Chef
chapters.text:
Chip was a dino chef. Chip had a big chef hat and a shiny dish.

"What shall I make?" said Chip. "I wish to make lunch for the whole pack!"

Chip put fresh fish in the dish. Chip put thick chunks of squash in the dish. Chip put chips on the shelf.

Whoosh! The wind shook the shed. Crash! The dish shook too.

"Which way did my lunch go?" said Chip.

Chip shut the shed. Chip checked the shelf. Chip checked the chest. Then Chip checked the path.

There! Three dino chicks had the fish. They had the squash. They had the chips!

The chicks did not munch. They did not chomp. They shared with Chip!

"Thanks, chicks," said Chip. "This is the best lunch. Munch, crunch, chomp!"

Did you wish for more dino facts? Kids can check National Geographic Kids. It has dino facts, dino art, and dino games. Such fun!

transcript.title: Lilani and the Dino Cave
transcript.text:
Lilani and her brother Eesa share one dream at night.

In the dream, they ride a kind dino down a stone lane.

They come to a wide cave. Inside, it is bright as day!

A baby dino is stuck by a huge rock. He makes a small whine.

"We can save him!" says Lilani.

Eesa takes a long pine pole. He uses it like a lever. The rock slides!

The baby is safe. He gives Lilani's hand a lick with his tongue.

His mom comes home. She is the size of a house! But she is not mean. She smiles.

She gives them a ride on her spine, back up the lane.

Then the dream fades. Lilani wakes. Eesa wakes.

"Same dream?" she asks.

"Same dream," he smiles.
transcript.cover_scene: Two children riding on the back of a gentle dinosaur toward a glowing wide cave at night.

chapters.title: Chomp Finds a Chunk
chapters.text:
Chomp was a small dino. Chomp liked to munch.

Chomp ran to the branch. On the branch was a bunch of red fruit.

"I wish I could reach!" said Chomp.

Chomp gave the branch a push. A chunk of fruit fell. Chomp did a little chomp. Crunch! Munch!

Then Chomp chose one more chunk. Crunch, crunch, munch!

A chick ran up. The chick did not have lunch.

"Do you wish for a chunk?" said Chomp.

The chick gave a chirp. Chomp put a chunk in a dish. The chick ate the chunk in the dish. Crunch!

Chomp and the chick sat on the branch. They ate lunch. Munch, munch, crunch!

Some kids read facts about dinos like Chomp. Chomp is a hit!

Chomp gave a big chomp and did not wish for one more thing.

transcript.title: The Dino at the Aquarium
transcript.text:
Maya goes to the aquarium. She sees a real octopus!

It has eight arms. It creeps on the glass and peeks at her.

"Long ago, sea reptiles ruled here," says the guide. "They were not dinosaurs, but they lived at the same time."

Maya sees a big bone shape on the wall. It has a long neck and flat feet like oars.

"That one ate fish," says the guide. "It could not walk on land. It swam."

Maya leans close to the tank. A ray floats by. Eels hide in the reef.

A seal claps its tail. The crowd cheers.

Maya eats a snack by the window. Boats sail past on the bay.

She dreams of a sea dino in that deep green water.

"I will read all about them," she says.

chapters.title: Chet the Deep-Sea Fish
chapters.text:
Chet is a small fish. Chet lives deep, deep down in the sea.

It is dark down there. No sun. Just cold water and soft mud.

One day, a ship sent down a light. Swish! Chet swam past it. Swish! Chet swam past it again.

The light was a camera. Up on the ship, a team of scientists sat and watched.

"Look!" said one. "A new fish! No one has seen this fish!"

They did not wish for a big, scary beast. They got Chet. Chet is pink. Chet is soft. Chet has a chin like a chip.

"He is adorable," said the scientist. That made her grin.

Chet did a flip. Splash! Swish! He did not chomp. He did not dash.

Chet is a snailfish. He lives two miles down. Now we can wish him well.

Swish, swish, Chet. Swim home.

transcript.title: The Giant with the Heavy Tail
transcript.text:
Maya reads the dino news. A new giant was found!

Its name is Dreadnoughtus. It is one of the biggest dinos we know.

It was as long as a whole train. Its tail was so heavy!

Maya paints a picture of it. She uses green and brown paint.

In her mind she sees it. The giant walks by a stream. Its feet leave deep tracks in the clay.

It reaches up to eat leaves from the tallest tree. It eats all day. It needs a lot of food!

No beast can beat it. It is too big. It just roams the plain and eats.

Then rain falls. The giant drinks. It sleeps by the oak trees.

Maya hangs her painting by her bed.

"Sleep well, big one," she says. "See you in my dreams."

chapters.title: Chan and the Pink Snailfish
chapters.text:
Chan is a small crab. Chan has a wish.

"I wish to see a new fish," said Chan.

Swish! Chan went down. Swish, swish, dash!

Down, down, down. It is dark. Chan is not scared.

A chum named Chet swam past. "Chan! Chan! Come see!"

Chet and Chan made a dash. Splash!

There, in the deep, was a little pink fish.

"It is a snailfish," said Chet. "Real ones live way, way down. Some people saw one and said it was cute!"

The pink fish did a flip. Swish!

Chan had to grin. "My wish came true! Not a big scary fish. Just a cute one."

The snailfish swam close. Swish, swish.

"Chan, Chet, I will show you my home," it said.

So Chan and Chet and the pink fish went on a dash in the deep.

Swish! Splash! What a wish!
